close_reason: Fixed in commit b1be5a3: async marker and .await call-site uses dropped across all 6 sibling client crates.
description:
tests/helpers.rs:51 `pub async fn make_client(server: &MockServer) -> SessionClient` has no `.await` inside. clippy::unused_async fires.

Calling site: `let sc = helpers::make_client(&server).await;`. Drop the `async` and the `.await` — function is purely synchronous. Currently it is misleading: a reader sees `async fn` and assumes there is I/O happening; there is not.

Probably written as async because make_session is shaped like it could become async later (it's not). Not a bug, but inflates the test surface and confuses readers.
title: make_client is async but has no .await — async marker is misleading
